data.body_html:
Sotogrande golf transfers by boat from Marbella offer the smoothest, most luxurious way to reach one of Europe's finest golf destinations. Instead of sitting in Costa del Sol traffic on the AP-7, you'll cruise from Puerto Banús to Sotogrande marina in just 30 minutes aboard a private yacht. Whether you're teeing off at Real Club de Golf Sotogrande, Valderrama, or La Reserva, arriving by boat sets the tone for a day of excellence. Our fleet includes yachts up to 29 metres, with all charters including a licensed skipper, drinks, and snacks.

Why Choose a Boat Transfer for Sotogrande Golf

The drive from Marbella to Sotogrande can take 45–90 minutes during peak season, especially on summer weekends. A boat transfer eliminates that friction entirely. Departing from Puerto Banús, you'll be on the water within minutes, passing the iconic Marbella coastline, Cabopino, and the dunes of Artola before arriving at Sotogrande's modern marina. The crossing is smooth, scenic, and far more relaxing than navigating the AP-7 toll road.

Our Fleet for Golf Transfers

We offer boats for groups of 5 to 12 passengers. For smaller parties, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are nimble and cost-effective. For larger groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are popular choices at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. If you want to make a statement, charter the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) or Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax)—both include a jet ski on the Mangusta 80 (minimum 4 hours, €4,719). All boats depart from Puerto Banús.

Pricing for Sotogrande Golf Transfers

We keep pricing transparent. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, with skipper, drinks, and VAT included. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80 white and grey) start at €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours and include a free jet ski. For all other boats—Azimut 58 Flybridge, Canados 86, Ferretti 94, K80, Maiora 26m, and more—pricing is available on request via WhatsApp. No hidden fees, no surprises.

What's Included in Every Charter

  • Licensed skipper
  • Fuel
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

You only need to bring your golf clubs, sunscreen, and a sense of occasion.

Golf Courses Near Sotogrande Marina

From Sotogrande marina, you're minutes away from world-class golf. Real Club de Golf Sotogrande (designed by Robert Trent Jones Sr.) is a 5-minute drive. Valderrama, host of the 1997 Ryder Cup, is 10 minutes away. La Reserva Club and Almenara are also within easy reach. We can arrange taxi or buggy transfers to any course—just let us know when you book.

How to Book Your 2026 Sotogrande Golf Transfer

Bookings are handled exclusively via WhatsApp. Send us your preferred date, group size, and boat type. We'll confirm availability and provide a quote. For Tier A boats, you can book instantly at the fixed rates above. For other yachts, we'll respond within hours. Explore our full fleet and start planning your luxury golf day from Marbella.
